description: Eight composite patients — one session spans multiple CCS domains. Merged order stacks at play time.

cases.title: Elena — Progressive Weakness
cases.briefingNote: One patient, four weakness presentations you would otherwise drill as separate CCS cases.
cases.objective: Stabilize and work up progressive weakness across neuromuscular differentials — MG, GBS, and mimics.
cases.chiefComplaint: Progressive weakness over weeks with ptosis, limb fatigability, and dyspnea on exertion.

cases.title: James — Chest Pain and Dyspnea
cases.briefingNote: Chest pain and dyspnea in one admission — cardio + pulmonary orders without switching patients.
cases.objective: Evaluate chest pain and dyspnea with overlapping cardiac and pulmonary pathways.
cases.chiefComplaint: Substernal chest pressure and worsening shortness of breath over 24 hours.

cases.title: Maria — Abdominal Pain
cases.briefingNote: Four abdominal-pain CCS variants merged — efficient surgical / medical / OB-GYN screening.
cases.objective: Diagnose and manage abdominal pain across surgical, inflammatory, and obstructive etiologies.
cases.chiefComplaint: Progressive abdominal pain with nausea — location and character evolve during the stay.

cases.title: David — Severe Headache
cases.briefingNote: Headache and AMS threads in one neuro admission — SAH, meningitis, and mass lesions.
cases.objective: Rule out life-threatening headache and AMS causes before symptomatic treatment.
cases.chiefComplaint: Worst headache of life with intermittent confusion and photophobia.

cases.title: Aisha — Pelvic Pain
cases.briefingNote: Pelvic and urinary complaints in one reproductive-age patient — OB, GU, and STI overlap.
cases.objective: Evaluate pelvic pain and urinary symptoms with pregnancy and infection rule-outs.
cases.chiefComplaint: Lower abdominal and pelvic pain with dysuria for several days.

cases.title: Robert — Marathon Collapse
cases.briefingNote: Marathon collapse on a hot day — knee trauma, leg vascular vs infectious, acute and chronic back pain, rhabdo, and occult heart failure in one thorough admission.
cases.objective: Work up marathon collapse with four MSK pain domains — knee septic/crystal, leg vascular vs cellulitis, acute and chronic back, plus rhabdo and cardiac screen.
cases.chiefComplaint: Collapsed during a marathon with a hot swollen knee, leg pain, low back pain after a fall, and dark urine.

cases.title: Sophie — Fever and Rash
cases.briefingNote: Fever and rash variants in one admission — meningococcemia, viral exanthem, and drug reaction.
cases.objective: Stabilize febrile rash and identify infectious vs allergic etiologies.
cases.chiefComplaint: Fever, diffuse rash, and lethargy worsening over 48 hours.

cases.title: Marcus — Anxiety and Low Mood
cases.briefingNote: Psychiatric presentations with mandatory medical and AMS rule-outs in one encounter.
cases.objective: Assess anxiety and depression while excluding organic AMS and substance causes.
cases.chiefComplaint: Panic attacks, low mood, and episodes of confusion — family worried about safety.

cases.title: Maya — School Refusal
cases.briefingNote: One pediatric patient — worry, refusal, sleep, and focus threads you'd otherwise drill as separate psych items.
cases.objective: Evaluate school refusal and multi-domain anxiety; rule out medical causes; plan psychotherapy and stepped pharmacotherapy.
cases.chiefComplaint: Morning stomachaches, won't go to school, worries constantly that kids will laugh at her.

cases.title: Jordan — Mood Crash
cases.briefingNote: One college-age patient — mood cycling, suicide safety, panic chest pain, and worry threads you'd otherwise drill as separate psych items.
cases.objective: Recognize bipolar spectrum, avoid antidepressant trap, assess suicide risk, and rule out panic masquerading as chest pain.
cases.chiefComplaint: Depressive crash after sleepless spending spree, passive death wishes, recent chest tightness.

cases.title: Darius — Paranoia and Voices
cases.briefingNote: Psychosis with mandatory organic, tox, and emergency overlap — one admission spans five CCS psych/neuro threads.
cases.objective: Evaluate new psychosis with command hallucinations; rule out encephalitis, tox, and metabolic causes before anchoring on primary psychotic disorder.
cases.chiefComplaint: Paranoia, command auditory hallucinations, social withdrawal, poor intake.

cases.title: Tom — Alcohol Withdrawal
cases.briefingNote: Alcohol withdrawal, DT risk, sedative tox overlap, and post-intentional safety in one chronic-use patient.
cases.objective: Manage alcohol withdrawal with CIWA benzos and thiamine; monitor for DT; address sedative overdose overlap and safety.
cases.chiefComplaint: Tremor, diaphoresis, visual hallucinations 36 hours after last drink — prior DT.

cases.title: Amina — Trauma Symptoms
cases.briefingNote: Trauma, forensic, endocrine mimic, anxiety, and capacity threads merged for one adult patient — trauma-informed throughout.
cases.objective: Care for post-assault PTSD symptoms and dissociation; offer forensic pathway; rule out medical mimics; assess capacity and safety for discharge.
cases.chiefComplaint: Intrusive trauma memories, dissociative episodes, hypervigilance, mirror preoccupation.
